name: Campfire Tales
hook: One story, one word each. The fire adds twists.
how: Sit round the fire and build a story together, a word or two each, in turn, before your timer runs out. Now and then the fire throws in a twist. At the end the story is read aloud and everyone votes for the best word.
controls: Type a word and press Enter, or tap one of the suggestions; tap a word to vote
uses: One player's browser keeps the turn order, the twists and the timer, and counts the votes; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot storytellers fill the circle and add words of their own until friends join.
Every word appears round the fire for everyone the moment it's added.
The fire keeps its last few stories; save any to your device or share it as text.
The most votes a player's words got in one story.
ideas: Make it a spooky ghost-story night with scarier twists
Let everyone pick the story's opening line by vote
Draw a picture for each sentence of the story
